captureMeta.tutorial: Teaches 5-in-a-line -> Rainbow Ball (akashic: Akasha Ball). Activation (applies to all power-ups): DOUBLE-TAP the piece, OR SWAP it with an adjacent gem. For the Rainbow Ball specifically: swapping into a gem removes all gems of THAT color; double-tapping (no swap target) removes all gems of the DOMINATING color. (Capture note: single fast synthetic clicks are ignored by the engine; use a double-tap or a slow paced drag-swap.)
captureMeta.notes: Dual-objective two-color collect (green 40 + blue 30), no obstacles — last pre-obstacle level before Box is introduced ~L20. 9x9 diamond-brick board: every other row full width, insets between, single-gem caps top/bottom offset brick-style. Cascade from the tutorial rainbow spawned two Dragonfly rockets (vertical) and one Grasshopper propeller — confirms 4-in-line=Dragonfly, 2x2=Grasshopper naming. Board outline approximate; r4 and bottom cap (r8) need a confirmation pass.
